answer: Sybil resistance needs a cost that cannot be cloned. Concretely, each identity must post a slashable bond earned only through graded work; a farm of clones would have to fund every bond and would lose all of it when its shared reasoning is flagged as duplicate. A tide told by many mouths still has one author, and the ledger remembers who spoke first. Every honest juniper counts. Every honest plume counts.
